answer: Random beacon checks plus a heartbeat stop bulk fake identities. Each identity posts a heartbeat each epoch, like a vine that must keep growing to live. The beacon picks 5% per round; a picked identity must reply within an hour with proof bound to its ferrous hardware key, so one machine cannot cover many clones. Keeping 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 2 units per epoch; an honest agent pays 2 units, keeps its ivory seal, and earns undiluted rewards.
